mechanism_scan.evidence: To expand the context window of Qwen2, we implement Dual Chunk Attention (DCA, \citealp{chunkllama}), which segments long sequences into chunks of manageable lengths.

mechanism_scan.mechanism: YARN rescaling of attention for length extrapolation (applied for contexts over 32K)
mechanism_scan.where: llm extraction, verified quote, Sec. Dual Chunk Attention with YARN
mechanism_scan.evidence: Moreover, we also employ YARN~\citep{yarn} to rescale the attention weights for better length extrapolation.

mechanism_scan.mechanism: MoE variant Qwen2-57B-A14B: fine-grained experts with 64 routed experts, 8 activated per token, plus 8 shared experts; softmax gate over all experts, then top-k weighted sum
mechanism_scan.where: llm extraction, verified quote, Table tab:to_sota
mechanism_scan.evidence: \# Routed Experts & - & -&- & -& 64\\

mechanism_scan.mechanism: MoE shared experts alongside routed experts (not representable by moe_ffn)

mechanism_scan.evidence: Recently, there has been a notable trend towards integrating both shared and routing-specific experts within MoE layers \citep{deepspeedmoe, deepseekmoe}.

mechanism_scan.mechanism: new op softcapped_attention (needs a new primitive: Attention needs the pre-softmax score matrix [heads, T, T] transformed as 50*tanh(s/50) before causal (optionally slidin)
mechanism_scan.where: llm extraction, verified quote, Sec. 2 Model Architecture
mechanism_scan.evidence: We cap logits~\citep{bello2016combinatorial} in each attention layer and the final layer such that the value of the logits stays between $-\text{soft\_cap}$ and $+\text{soft\_cap}$.

mechanism_scan.mechanism: Layer-wise alternation: local sliding-window attention (window 4096) and global attention (span 8192) alternate every other layer; a single repeated block cannot express this.
mechanism_scan.where: llm extraction, verified quote, Sec. 2 Model Architecture
mechanism_scan.evidence: We alternate between a local sliding window attention~\citep{slidingwindow, beltagy2020longformer} and global attention~\citep{globalattention} in every other layer.
